name: diffbot-mcp
description: Web knowledge fetching tools for your agent.
long_description:
Diffbot is an applied AI lab building models that structure all of human knowledge. This extension runs the Diffbot MCP server on your machine: web extraction and search over Diffbot's independent web index, site crawls, entity resolution, and queries against the 10-billion-entity Diffbot Knowledge Graph.

A free Diffbot token is required for tool use: https://app.diffbot.com/get-started. Paste it below, or leave it blank if you already keep a DIFFBOT_API_TOKEN line in ~/.diffbot/credentials, the file the db CLI and diffbot-skills read.

diffbot_api_token.title: Diffbot API token
diffbot_api_token.description: Free token from https://app.diffbot.com/get-started. Leave blank to use a DIFFBOT_API_TOKEN line in ~/.diffbot/credentials instead.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Fetch a page and return its content as structured JSON instead of raw HTML

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Search Diffbot's independent web index, and read its cached copy of a page with url:<URL>

tools.name: crawl
tools.description: Crawl a site from a seed URL as a background job and extract every page it finds

tools.name: resolve_entities
tools.description: Recognize organizations, people, and places in text and resolve them to Knowledge Graph IDs

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search news and articles by entity, topic, publisher, language, date range, or sentiment

tools.name: search_organizations
tools.description: Search companies by industry, location, headcount, revenue, funding, ownership, or leadership

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search people by title, employer, skills, education, location, or nationality

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search cities, regions, countries, and points of interest by name, population, or proximity

tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search funding rounds, investments, and acquisitions by date, size, series, investor, or acquirer

tools.name: dql
tools.description: Run a raw Diffbot Query Language query against the Knowledge Graph

tools.name: dql_probe
tools.description: Return hit counts for several candidate DQL queries in parallel

tools.name: dql_ontology
tools.description: Look up Knowledge Graph entity types, fields, taxonomies, and enums
